prompt:
You review IMPACT front-view videos to prepare anomaly MCQs for HUMAN review. Produce concise Chinese visual facts and evidence-based judgments. The video contains the complete supplied source-time context, sampled nonuniformly. Read SOURCE timestamps and frame IDs: encoded playback speed is not real elapsed time. The small side image gives full-frame context. Left/right means the person's anatomical hand, not image side. Multiple numbered targets may occur in one video; each question concerns ONLY its supplied hand and source interval.

INPUTS: fallible action/step annotations, target times, proposed category hypotheses, and the video. Hypotheses may originate from GT or statistical rules. They are not proof of error. Describe actual observations before evaluating them. Never invent a reason to match a proposed label. Preserve uncertainty, including occluded contact or unknown placement requirements. Make a separate judgment for every proposed category; you may identify additional categories with their own evidence.

REFERENCES: In Model A, the red/yellow Phillips driver operates the two long adapter-plate screws with their nuts; the green/black six-lobed Torx driver operates the bearing-plate and locking-lever screws. The silver combination wrench acts on the internal shaft/gear retaining nut. M4/M6 labels may conflict; avoid unsupported size claims. Model B bearing-plate disassembly has a black/blue flat-head driver reference; do not copy A's adapter/lever assembly to B. Identify the actual target, interface and stage before requiring a tool. Color alone is insufficient.

RULES:
temporal: sustained non-initiation or ineffective progress despite ready prerequisites; exclude productive work, alignment/checking and other-hand progress. NULL/hold and elapsed time alone are insufficient. Do not infer thoughts.
MOVEMENT IS NOT PROGRESS. Repeated turning, gripping or repositioning may be the very inefficiency being annotated. For temporal=contradicted, require a visible state transition (e.g. fastener actually removed, component seated) or specific support of another hand's visibly effective action. Motion alone, a plausible normal purpose, or saying "continuous adjustment" is insufficient. Use the progress field to make this distinction explicit; do not call testing productive unless the test or its useful outcome is visible. State changes hidden by fingers remain unclear.
spatial: visible wrong placement/orientation relative to an identified applicable requirement. A reach is not necessarily release; temporary table placement is not universally wrong.
handling: inappropriate manipulation/control/method for the current stage. Finger starting before tool tightening and finger removal after tool loosening can be normal. Hand-turning a shaft can serve alignment/testing; inspect actual relative motion and purpose.
wrong_part: the identified part/fastener is inappropriate for the current target. Same-part reorientation or trial fitting is not proof of wrong identity.
wrong_tool: actual tool use is incompatible with the target interface/stage. Holding a tool while fingers work is not automatically wrong.
procedural: violation of a known necessary step or prerequisite. Allow alternative valid orders, trial fitting, and recovery disassembly during reassembly.

FEW-SHOT:
Tool loosens screw, fingers finish removal, small item is stored: describe the effective removal. Do not justify Handling just because a screwdriver remains in hand.
A part is held while the other hand tightens effectively: do not call the whole task waiting. If progress cannot be resolved, temporal=insufficient.
The same adapter is withdrawn, rotated and retried: wrong_part=insufficient unless its identity is actually unsuitable; consider alignment/recovery.
Changing red/yellow to green at the same A bearing-plate fastener is a wrong-tool candidate only when the target continuity and incompatible contact are visible. A tool change alone is insufficient.

OUTPUT: One item for each event_id. facts: one or two concrete sentences about tool/part/action/progress, no invented hidden mechanics. progress_evidence: the concrete state transition or its visibility limit, in one short sentence. checks: each proposed category exactly once, with supported/contradicted/insufficient. Give a short reason connecting observation and applicable requirement, and one short alternative/uncertainty. evidence_frame_ids MUST come from inside that target; context_frame_ids may cite supplied surrounding frames for prerequisite/correction. A supported judgment needs at least two target frames. contradicted requires positive visual counter-evidence, not merely an alternative possibility; invisibility means insufficient. Do not claim all non-mentioned categories absent. Keep each reason within 100 Chinese characters and facts within 140. No overall certainty percentages. These are unverified model proposals, never final human answers.
